prompt: As of August 3, 2024, which band was nominated three times for the Grammy Award for Best Metal Performance and also headlined the Opus Stage at Download Festival 2023?
answer: The band was **Lamb of God**. They had been nominated three times for the Grammy Award for Best Metal Performance— for **“Redneck” (2007), “Set to Fail” (2010), and “In Your Words” (2011)**—and headlined Download Festival 2023’s **Opus Stage**.
